_about: The ways of naming people in a village (#38; src/core/naming.js; docs/WORLD.md). A person is called by a word of kinship to the child and a word after it (#41): the order of birth in the family (cô Năm, chú Tư), the name of the first child (ông Dương), or the own small name (chị Hến), never by a nickname from the work. kin: the words of kinship (the keys kin.<id> of the language files) and the pronoun of the English gloss. ages: the rule of each age of a person (elder, grown, young): order, child, own, or order-child (the order and the name of the first child, chị Hai Tùng). A person with no field for the rule gets the order. same: the rule for two people of one place with the same name. orders: the word for the first, second, ... child; youngest: the youngest child. north: the first child is Cả and the second Hai (the north, and all regions before the 18th century). south: the first child is Hai (the center and the south from the 18th century on; Nguyễn Nhạc, the eldest Tây Sơn brother, was anh Hai Trầu before 1771). Each region of data/world/regions.json names its way (naming). Sources: Báo Cà Mau, https://baocamau.vn/tai-sao-nguoi-mien-nam-goi-anh-ca-la-anh-hai--a5375.html; Báo Pháp Luật, https://baophapluat.vn/thu-vi-su-khac-biet-cua-gia-dinh-viet-cac-vung-mien-post221458.html; Biên khảo, https://sites.google.com/site/bienkhao/t%E1%BA%A1i-sao-ng%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Di-mi%E1%BB%81n-nam-g%E1%BB%8Di-anh-c%E1%BA%A3-l%C3%A0-anh-hai. Names by a child and small names (#41): Mien Cao 2018, https://dothogiadinh.vn/cach-xung-ho-ten-cua-nguoi-viet.html; Cao Thu Cúc, https://caothucuc.wordpress.com/2014/06/16/cach-xung-ho-cua-nguoi-viet-nam/; Soha, https://soha.vn/vi-sao-nguoi-xua-hay-dat-ten-xau-cho-tre-198260905160854986.htm; Toan Ánh, Nếp cũ, in Znews, https://znews.vn/tuc-kieng-goi-ten-to-tien-cua-nguoi-viet-post1648087.html.
